justification: Image A depicts a procession of figures leading a camel in profile relief, while Image B is a stele-like composition with a radiating sun disc, figures before an offering table, and dense columns of hieroglyphic-style text; the only loose commonality is the presence of standing human figures. There is no shared animal, no shared object (camel vs. sun disc/altar), and no corresponding arrangement or relationship between elements, so the depicted content is essentially unrelated beyond the generic presence of people.
